title: Exploring the Multifactorial Regulation of PIEZO1 in Chondrocytes: Mechanisms and Implications.
source_quotation: A: Overview of PIEZO1 Regulation in Chondrocytes. Mechanical Stress: Both physiological and pathological mechanical stress regulate PIEZO1 activation, impacting cartilage function and health.
